newsitem.title: USA: Roto-Rooter Inc sees Chemed offer as fair.
newsitem.headline: Roto-Rooter Inc sees Chemed offer as fair.

text.p: Roto-Rooter Inc has described as fair a tender offer made by Chemed Corp to buy all of its outstanding stock that the company did not already own.

Chemed said Tuesday a special committee set up by Roto-Rooter to study its offer to buy 2,160,000 shares, or 42 percent of its outstanding stock, had decided to remain neutral regarding the proposed deal.
Chemed's offer, which would be to pay $41 in cash for every share, is scheduled to expire at midnight on September 11 unless extended.
Chemed is a diversified public corporation, while Roto-Rooter provides sewer and drain cleaning services. Both of them are based in Cincinnati.
